confirmed.oneLine: Campus Maintenance Complaint Management System (LASU)

Web-based platform digitising the full lifecycle of campus maintenance complaints at LASU - submission -> AI triage (Vercel AI SDK + OpenAI gpt-4o-mini) -> SLA-bounded assignment -> transparent resolution -> reporting. Replaces manual/informal channels with a single source of truth.

(1) Single source of truth for campus maintenance complaints at LASU; (2) Reduce response delays via SLA + escalation up DICT hierarchy; (3) Transparency through live status, proof-of-fix photo, anonymous mode; (4) Demonstrate lightweight AI-augmented stack is replicable at peer universities.

Reporter submits (category+location+description+photo+anonymous) -> validate -> duplicate-detection (30-min window) -> AI triage (gpt-4o-mini via Vercel AI SDK with Zod) -> severity -> SLA-table lookup -> persist with aiSuggestion -> admin /admin/queue assigns -> Ably push to technician -> ack within SLA window (else escalate) -> In Progress with notes/photos -> Resolved with mandatory proof-of-fix photo -> reporter sees timeline + photo -> Recharts dashboard updates.

Ten features: Reporter Portal; AI-Assisted Triage; DICT Admin Console; DICT Technician View; SLA Engine + Escalation; Real-time Push (Ably); Reporting Dashboard (Recharts + @react-pdf/renderer); Auth & RBAC (BetterAuth, 3 roles); Server-side Image Pipeline (sharp + Cloudinary); Duplicate Detection.

Reporter+resolver roles; responsive web (no native mobile); AI triage with rules fallback; 4-tier SLA policy with auto-escalation; anonymous mode; reporter dashboard+proof photo; admin reports with Recharts+PDF/CSV; real-time via Ably; sharp+Cloudinary image pipeline; duplicate detection; Mongoose validation; BetterAuth sessions; Arcjet + @upstash/ratelimit rate limiting; Jest+RTL tests; JMeter/k6 load tests.

Native mobile apps; IoT/sensor predictive maintenance; multi-tenant; University SSO/LDAP; ML fine-tuned triage; local-language UI (Yoruba/pidgin/Hausa); email/SMS channels; asset/inventory registry; non-maintenance grievances; on-device/self-hosted LLM.

All five 1.4 objectives implemented and test-verified. SLA targets met (median ack <1h Critical, <24h High). Tan five-factor service-quality lens addressed. Performance: p95<4s POST /api/complaints at typical load+AI, <1% errors. Reliability: AI fallback within OPENAI_TIMEOUT_MS. Cost: <=$5/month AI for <=50k submissions. UAT pass >=90%. Pilot >=50% of LASU complaints via system by end of academic year.

Run Next.js 16 App Router + Node LTS + React 19 + TS5 strict; Tailwind4 + shadcn/ui + Radix; BetterAuth (nextCookies plugin); MongoDB Atlas + Mongoose 8; Vercel AI SDK + OpenAI gpt-4o-mini; Zod at boundaries; Ably push; BullMQ+Upstash Redis for cron/jobs; Cloudinary+sharp for images; Recharts+@react-pdf/renderer; Arcjet+@upstash/ratelimit; isomorphic-dompurify; next-themes; jest+RTL+k6+JMeter; lucide-react icons; Vercel hosting with cron; Git VCS.

Three-tier (Presentation / Application / Data). Presentation = Next.js RSC+client components under /app/. Application = /app/api/ route handlers + Server Actions as the only paths that touch Mongoose models in /lib/db/models/. Data = 8 Mongoose collections in /lib/db/models/ exclusively. Cross-cutting: cron/scheduled work goes through the application tier; Ably pushes initiated by application tier; AI calls made from application tier (key never reaches client); all input schemas validated by Zod before mutation.

Eight Mongoose collections in single cms_lasu DB: users (BetterAuth-compatible), categories (systemType+severity+SLA hours), locations (name+area), complaints (with aiSuggestion sub-doc + parentComplaintId), assignments, statusHistory (append-only audit), notifications (assignment/escalation/status), reports (optional aggregate). Indexes on complaints.slaResolveBy, complaints.status, complaints.categoryId, complaints.locationId, complaints.createdAt, assignments.complaintId, users.email unique, users.role, notifications.recipientId.

BetterAuth with three role classes (reporter, dicht_admin, dicht_technician); bcrypt cost>=12; HTTP-only cookie sessions 7-day expiry via nextCookies plugin; middleware in /lib/auth/middleware.ts on every protected request. Route groups: /app/api/admin/* + /app/(admin)/* admin-only; /app/api/technician/* + /app/(technician)/* technician-only; /app/api/complaints any of three; anonymous reporter uses signed token, isAnonymous=true, reporterId null, anonymousId populated. PII discipline: strip users.* from AI prompts (NFR-3.5/6), rationale visible to admins only.

Domain: status transitions only forward along state machine; status===Resolved requires proofPhotoUrl in latest statusHistory; escalation notifications must have complaintId+recipientId; slaAcknowledgeBy<slaResolveBy at write time; duplicate complaints have parentComplaintId; users.email unique. Process: reporter role never transitions; technician never reassigns; only admin overrides SLA timers; cron sla-sweep idempotent; Ably best-effort with notifications row fallback. Cost: monthly AI>$5 forces fallback; >$50 forces model switch/stop.

One feature per PR; tests run before push (npm test + lint); commit subject<=72 chars imperative mood; PRs cite Unit ID + source section (academic doc Sx.x or developer brief or context file); no any; no console.log in committed code; comments explain why not what; cross-reference academic doc and Developer Brief when implementing.

TS 5.x strict mode with noUncheckedIndexedAccess and exactOptionalPropertyTypes. No any - prefer unknown + z.infer. Shared types in /lib/types/. Per-route types co-located. Runtime validation is Zod's job at every API boundary; schema -> types via z.infer -> logic. null for absent value expected to be checked; undefined reserved for unset field.

Next.js 16 App Router only. Routes under /app/ with role-grouped segments: (reporter)/(admin)/(technician) and /app/api/. RSC default; use client only with state/browser APIs/event handlers. Server Actions for mutations over internal REST; API routes reserved for external/sync read. next/image with Cloudinary loader; next/font for fonts; Metadata API for SEO; generateStaticParams where applicable.

Tailwind 4 only - no CSS-in-JS/SCSS/CSS modules. Utilities in JSX, no @apply in committed code. Tokens from tailwind.config.ts (colors/fontFamily/borderRadius/boxShadow/animation). next-themes toggles class=dark; Tailwind dark: variants. shadcn/ui vendored under /components/ui/. Icons via lucide-react through shadcn wrapper. Skeleton loaders over spinners; explicit empty states with CTA.

/app/api/<resource>/route.ts pattern; only GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE named exports. Per handler: auth (BetterAuth+role), rate limit (Arcjet+@upstash/ratelimit), validate (Zod), compute (incl AI/queue), persist (Mongoose), return (NextResponse.json). Errors throw ApiError caught by error.tsx; success={data,meta?}, error={error:{code,message,details?}}; standard status codes; Idempotency-Key header on writes (24h cache); PII discipline (no logging request bodies or AI prompts containing PII).

All DB access via Mongoose models in /lib/db/models/; hand-rolled collection() forbidden. Models export InferSchemaType. Index creation in /lib/db/indexes.ts run on first connect. Photo URLs are Cloudinary HTTPS; raw file bytes never touch MongoDB. statusHistory.photoUrl + notifications.message are bounded strings. timestamps:true on every document. Sensitive fields scrubbed in centralised toPublicJSON mapper.

/app/ routes; /lib/ singletons (auth, db, ai, sla, utils); /components/ ui (shadcn) + reporter/ + admin/ + technician/ + shared/; /tests/ unit/integration/load/fixtures; /scripts/ seed + roles; /public/ static. Co-locate <feature>/types.ts with the route that uses them over a global /types/; reusable only when truly cross-cutting. Vendor shadcn components into /components/ui/ via components.json.

Tailwind CSS 4 standard palette as base; Astryx theme provides LOSU institutional skin overrides in tailwind.config.ts theme.extend (colors/typography/borderRadius). Light mode default; dark mode via next-themes (class=dark + Tailwind dark: variants). Standard density (gap-1 to gap-2). Institutional neutral identity, not playful.

brand (LASU green primary), accent (secondary actions and SLA countdown highlight), surface (bg white/slate-900), muted (slate-500/600), danger (red Critical), warning (amber High), success (emerald Low/resolved). Severity-to-color: Critical->danger, High->warning, Medium->accent, Low->muted. Always paired with text labels (never color-only signaling). Defaults to Tailwind palette; Astryx overrides in config.

Inter for body+headings via next/font/google, 14px text-sm base, 16px text-base. Tabular figures for SLA timers/countdowns so digits don't jiggle. JetBrains Mono for code blocks. Tailwind default line-height (leading-normal).
Cards rounded-lg (0.5rem), Buttons+Inputs rounded-md (0.375rem), Modals+Dialg rounded-xl (0.75rem), Severity badges rounded-full (pill).

shadcn/ui vendored under /components/ui/ via components.json (configured at scaffold). Initial set: Button, Card, Dialog, Form, Input, Label, Textarea, Select, Tabs, Tooltip, Toast/Sonner, Badge, Skeleton, Switch, Dropdown, Table, Pagination, Avatar, Progress, Command. Project-specific compositions in /components/{reporter|admin|technician|shared}/: ComplaintForm, ComplaintDetail, StatusTimeline, SlaCountdown, QueueTable, CategoryBadge, SeverityBadge, AiRationaleTooltip, ThemeToggle, ReporterDashboardEmpty.

Reporter: single-column mobile (Stack of cards), two-column desktop (sidebar status filters + main list). Admin: three-column desktop (filters left, queue centre, detail right when row selected); collapsed stacked on mobile. Technician: two-column mobile (assigned queue top, current complaint bottom); single-column desktop with sticky current-task card at top. Persistent top nav (brand mark + role-aware menu + theme toggle + sign-out). Mobile bottom nav (role-aware tabs). Modal max-width max-w-md forms / max-w-2xl details. Empty states: centred icon + paragraph + primary CTA.

Lucide icons via lucide-react through shadcn <Icon> wrapper. Size: h-4 w-4 inline, h-5 w-5 buttons, h-6 w-6 empty-state. Initial map: Wrench (category fallback); AlertTriangle (Critical); AlertCircle (High); Info (Medium); CheckCircle2 (Low/resolved); Camera (photo); Send (submit); Bell (notifications); UserCircle (account); FileText (report/export); ShieldCheck (anonymous toggle).

Feature-by-feature. One unit at a time (matches academic doc 3.3.2 sprint plan). Read all six context files before code (project-overview -> architecture -> code-standards -> ui-context -> ai-workflow-rules -> progress-tracker). Decisions go in docs first - no architectural/scope decision implemented before being recorded.

One user-facing capability per PR. PR <=400 lines of substantive change. PR description cites Unit ID + academic doc Sx.x / developer brief Sx.x / context file rule. No feature outside In Scope list without amending project-overview.md In Scope and removing from Out of Scope first.
At a module boundary (end of sprint). At a route boundary (one route = one unit). At a UI boundary (one component family). At a schema boundary (new collection = own unit).

Source resolution order: (1) Academic doc (Campus Maintenance Complaint Management System.md); (2) Developer Brief (AI Triage + Vercel AI SDK Migration); (3) Six context files ./context/. If still missing after three: STOP, do not invent. Add to progress-tracker.md Open Questions, surface to user/supervisor before proceeding. Forbidden: inventing new collections/roles/env vars; adding deps without justification; exposing admin-only routes or defaulting AI feature flag off without explicit sign-off.

AGENT.md + ./context/* are the SYSTEM OF RECORD. AI edits context/ only with explicit user instruction. No mass rewrites - small surgical edits with documented reason. Academic doc is product source of truth - treated as read-only by build agent unless user explicitly edits it. Developer Brief is alive but slow-moving. package.json: deps only when required by a unit. tsconfig.json: strict + noUncheckedIndexedAccess + exactOptionalPropertyTypes are the contract. tailwind.config.ts: tokens only revised when Astryx theme is genuinely revised.

After every meaningful implementation change, update ./context/progress-tracker.md (move unit In Progress->Completed; set Current Goal to next unit). After discovering a new truth (env var/constraint), update the relevant context file in the next commit, not later. PR description references which context file or academic doc section implemented.
